Its attack power is very high.|Allies|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Weapon |strength = 32 |durability = 15 |flammable = No |magnetic = Yes |buoyant = No |conductive = Yes |guardian = No |throw = Yes |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Royal Guard's Spear}} Royal Guard's Spears are [[Weapon]]s that are part of the [[Royal Guard's Series]].{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 168}} They were crafted by the [[Sheikah]] using [[Ancient Technology]] to fight the [[Great Calamity]], and while they have a high attack power, a design flaw left them with low durability. They can be found in the interior of [[Hyrule Castle (Dungeon)|Hyrule Castle]] as they are intended to be wielded by the [[Soldier]]s who previously served as guards. In the Castle, a Royal Guard's Spear can be found hidden in the fireplace in the [[Dining Hall]], and another can be found wielded by a [[Black Moblin]]. If [[Link]] speaks to [[Parcy]] at [[Riverside Stable]], she will reveal that she wants to find the gear that belonged to the [[Royal Guard]]s of Hyrule Castle.{{Cite|Have you gone to the giant castle north of here? That's Hyrule Castle. It's said to have fallen to ruin over a hundred years ago. I used to sneak in there to salvage ancient treasures, but it's too dangerous to go in there now. These days it's surrounded by an eerie mist and savage machine-like creatures. Back when it was safer, I went in looking for this ultra-rare equipment that once belonged to the {{Color BotW|Red|royal guard}}. It's legendary among collectors, but I was never able to find any...|Parcy|BotW}} The Royal Guard's Spear is one of the Weapons Link can bring to her for a reward, which Parcy immediately recognizes.{{Cite|Wait just a minute! Can you show me that spear you've got there?!|Parcy|BotW}} She will be grateful and give Link a [[Gold Rupee]] in return.{{Cite|Thank you. You have shown me something truly spectacular. I need to go out and find one of these myself.|Parcy|BotW}}{{Cite|Here's a token of my appreciation.|Parcy|BotW}} Following this exchange, Link can continue to trade Royal Guard's Spears to Parcy for a [[Topaz]], a [[Ruby]], or a [[Sapphire]].{{Cite|Hey, that spear... Will you trade it for a topaz?|Parcy|BotW}}{{Cite|Hey, that spear... Will you trade it for a ruby?|Parcy|BotW}}{{Cite|Hey, that spear... Will you trade it for a sapphire?|Parcy|BotW}} Royal Guard's Spears are made of metal, and they will therefore attract [[Lightning]] during [[Thunderstorm]]s and conduct [[Electricity]]. If Link drops them in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], they will sink, but they are incapable of burning when exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]].
